doc: The same model with a signal queue of 2: full at exactly 2 entries.

steps.doc: The root's initial transition emits s1 before A is entered; A's exit emits s2, B's entry s3. FIFO: s2 moves B to C, then s3 is dropped (B -s3-> Wrong would show LIFO order).
A signal emitted on the way into P is handled by P's second region, whose transition emits a signal for the first region.
Two transitions in one microstep emit s3 (upper region) then s1 (lower region), in the order they were taken. Fills the queue of 2 exactly.
Three signals in one microstep do not fit into a queue of 2.
The failed call left the machine half-way: process() refuses until reset().
